title: Volvi
tagline: Duration pricing protocol that automates price volatility exposure with yield opportunities.
description:
Unfinished.
Users commit to making capital available for option creation under specified parameters (duration, premium per unit of time, asset). Conterparties configure and mint options. Orderbook-like architecture. With gas sponsored, signature-only user interface. It is part of a chain of options protocols studies.
how_its_made: It's an iteration of a long chain of option protocol studies. Vincent as a framework is promising for automating decentralized market making yield opportunities for price exposure. Could also potentially create a market for low liquidity and early stage projects as well as highly liquid assets.
